verdict.rationale: Event-driven automation rules are a fair question for an FP&A SaaS platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only built-in automatic behavior, such as live actuals flowing in and decks updating, plus an audit history of edit events. Neither is a user-definable rule that triggers actions on events, so no direct support exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
